# Spec: Render a panel from a server-supplied definition

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/server-driven-ui.md)

**Start:** `/utilities/server-ui`  
**Persona:** A developer who wants one UI contract for every front end  
**Goal:** Open a UI definition and watch the host decide which controls show, enable and validate.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Open the definition | The Output section shows with Voltage disabled and its reason. |
| 2 | Enable the output and enter a bad value | Voltage accepts input and shows a range error. |
| 3 | Switch mode to reveal a section | The Current limit section appears with a Reset limit button. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `server-driven-ui`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
